items.item: The developed structure, opening mechanism, retention and component positions agree with the selected specification wherever depicted; opening and storage states remain physically compatible.

All developed surface artwork and package views express the selected visual direction, with coherent typography, graphic treatment and surface assignments; component-specific wording and functional layouts may differ.
Every visible component code retains the same meaning across alternatives, specifications and developed images: H1 basil pouch, H2 chives pouch, P pot, M mix sachet, K marker, T tray and C card.
Packing and storage depictions respect the fixed component records and distinguish the complete sixteen-piece kit from the smaller dry remainder after the first session.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Each board includes a closed-package view, an intelligible opening sequence and a packing map. Compare the boards for meaningful differences in both structure and visual treatment. Silhouette, opening, compartments and retention may vary within the fixed constraints; color-only variations or repeated structures do not establish three distinct structural directions.

Both first pages unambiguously identify the same supplied direction as selected. The presented review order places all three direction boards before the full selection/specification treatment; the required first-page selection label may appear earlier. Conflicting selections, an unidentified selection or a review sequence that bypasses the alternatives fails.

The document has three pages. Page 1 records the chosen direction and its structural specification, including material, thickness, assembled dimensions, opening method and component locations. Pages 2 and 3 assign the complete approved English copy to the named outer, H1, H2, M, P, K and C surfaces. Typography and grouping may vary, but missing copy, changed wording or reassignment to the wrong surface fails.

Each target explicitly states folding paperboard of nominal 0.6 mm thickness, the maximum closed envelope of 260 W × 190 D × 95 H mm including closure, and the same selected assembled dimensions. The selected dimensions must fit within the corresponding envelope limits. The material requirement applies to both the outer package and retention pieces. Equivalent dimension notation is acceptable; omissions, contradictions or an oversized closed assembly fail.

The outer sheet develops the selected box, and the retention sheet develops its insert and retaining pieces. Both provide readable physical panel dimensions, distinguish cutting, folding and gluing, and show the joining features needed for the depicted assembly. Panel and retention labels correspond to their assembled-view counterparts. Graphic conventions may vary if explained; mismatched identifiers, incompatible joining geometry or an assembly inconsistent with the selected structure fails.

Read each packing map independently and reconcile exactly one H1, one H2, four P, four M, four K, one T and one C. Count physical packing pieces, not individual seeds. Clearly labeled stack quantities are acceptable when their locations are shown; a total of sixteen without traceable component allocations, a missing piece or a duplicate fails.

The selected packing map accounts for H1 × 1, H2 × 1, P × 4, M × 4, K × 4, T × 1 and C × 1, with dimensioned allocations and explained removal clearances. Assess fit against H1/H2 at 55 × 75 × 3 mm each; P at outside diameter 60 mm and height 70 mm, inside diameter 56 mm and usable height 64 mm; M at 60 × 80 × 25 mm each; K at 15 × 80 × 1 mm; T at 142 × 142 × 18 mm with 132 × 132 mm clear interior and 2 mm base; and C at 100 × 140 × 0.4 mm. Account for board thickness where it affects fit. Any proposed stack or nest needs dimensional support compatible with the supplied shapes. Overlap, unsupported nesting or removal paths blocked by the structure fails.

The board makes component allocations and access clear through dimensions or keyed dimensional annotations. Shown removal paths have usable clearance and agree with the specification. Any nesting or stacking is supported by dimensions and the fixed component geometry. Perspective and exploded views are acceptable; hidden interference, components passing through intact panels or unexplained compression of fixed components fails.

Show four identifiable physical faces, each specified as 55 W × 75 H mm. Both fronts carry, in order, LEDGEKIN, the appropriate H1 BASIL or H2 CHIVES label, 20 SEEDS, and Seeds for sowing. Both backs carry First session: 2 seeds in one P pot.; the herb-specific Cover approximately 3 mm deep. for H1 or Cover approximately 6 mm deep. for H2; Keep the mix moist; allow excess water to drain.; and Reseal the remaining seeds and keep dry. Preserve the exact English wording and reading order. Layout and line wrapping may vary; swapped depths, missing faces or altered copy fails.

Include M front and back at the specified physical 60 W × 80 H mm face size, P identification, and the 15 W × 80 H mm K template. M front reads LEDGEKIN; M SEED-STARTING MIX; 100 mL; One sachet for one P pot. M back reads Moisten before sowing.; Use one herb per pot.; Keep unopened sachets dry. P reads P SEED-STARTING POT. K has HERB: followed by SOWN:, with writable space for the herb and sowing date. Preserve exact wording and reading order; typographic variation is allowed, but omitted labels, changed quantities or unusable marker fields fails.

Show both sides of C at the stated physical size of 100 W × 140 H mm. Preserve the following approved text and order, allowing line wrapping and typographic changes only. Front: LEDGEKIN; C START HERE; 1. Open and check the coded contents.; 2. Take two P pots, two M sachets, two K markers and T.; 3. Choose H1 BASIL and H2 CHIVES; keep their pouches identifiable.; 4. Put spare supplies in their dry storage places. Turn over to sow. Back: ONE BASIL POT + ONE CHIVES POT; 1. Fill each P with one M; moisten the mix.; 2. Sow 2 H1 seeds in one pot at about 3 mm; sow 2 H2 seeds in the other at about 6 mm.; 3. Mark each pot with its herb and sowing date.; 4. Keep the mix moist, drain excess water and keep the tray outside the dry box.; 5. Keep 18 H1 seeds, 18 H2 seeds, 2 P, 2 unopened M and 2 unused K dry for later.; After true leaves develop, thin to one healthy seedling per pot if needed.; Use a suitably lit protected place. Check local conditions before moving plants to a balcony.; Move to larger drained pots as seedlings outgrow these starters. No growth outcome is guaranteed. Missing instructions, altered allocation or depths, or unreadable copy fails.

Two closed copies of the selected structure collectively expose readable front and back faces. Front copy, in order: LEDGEKIN; BALCONY HERB STARTER; BASIL + CHIVES; Start two pots now. Keep supplies for later. Back copy, in order: Inside: H1 basil seeds × 20; H2 chives seeds × 20.; P pots × 4; M seed-starting mix × 4 (100 mL each).; K markers × 4; T catch tray × 1; C start card × 1.; Read C before opening the seeds.; Keep spare supplies dry and separate from watered pots.; Water, tools, lights and later growing pots not included. Preserve the exact English wording. Camera angle and line wrapping may vary if all required copy remains legible; obscured faces, changed facts or incomplete copy fails.

Four numbered views show the selected package closed, then C reachable while H1 and H2 remain unopened, then identifiable coded contents, then removal of two P, two M, two K and T for the first session. Codes retain their assigned component meanings. The outer front visibly carries LEDGEKIN, BALCONY HERB STARTER and the complete statement Start two pots now. Keep supplies for later. View composition may vary; premature pouch opening, missing stages, incorrect removal quantities or a changed opening mechanism fails.

An overhead dry-stock map identifies two unused P, two unopened M totaling 200 mL, two unused K, reclosed H1 and H2 containing eighteen seeds each, and retained C in the specified storage positions. Labels may establish concealed contents and seed counts. A closed-storage view shows T outside the dry package holding two watered P and their two used K, with two emptied M wrappers separately identifiable. Missing stock, wet items inside dry storage, conflicting positions or wrappers counted as unopened stock fails.

Review the whole video and its duration. It runs ten seconds and consistently develops the selected package from closed state to C access before either seed pouch opens, removal of two P, two M, two K and T, and the specified storage arrangement. The outer front carries readable LEDGEKIN, BALCONY HERB STARTER and Start two pots now. Keep supplies for later.; component codes remain stable. The final arrangement identifies two dry unused P, two unopened M totaling 200 mL, two unused K, reclosed H1 and H2 with eighteen seeds each, and C at their specified positions, while two watered P and two used K occupy T outside the closed package. Cuts, annotations and animation are acceptable if the sequence and inventory remain clear; missing stages, changed selection or contradictory quantities fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation contains at least eight pages and visibly incorporates identifiable material from every source role, including both the selection and structural specification from the specification document. Resizing, cropping and page recomposition are acceptable when the reused work remains recognizable and relevant information survives. Text-only mentions of missing artwork or replacement designs that cannot be matched to the delivered sources fail.

The presentation's storage material establishes two unused P, two unopened M totaling 200 mL, two unused K, reclosed H1 and H2 with eighteen seeds each, and retained C. Locations agree with the specification and storage board, and two watered P with two used K are shown in T outside the closed dry package. Readable labels may establish hidden contents; omissions, inconsistent quantities or wet/dry placement conflicts fail.

An outer-front depiction in the presentation visibly carries the exact brand, descriptor and full statement: LEDGEKIN; BALCONY HERB STARTER; Start two pots now. Keep supplies for later. Body-text mentions alone do not satisfy surface placement. Throughout the document, H1 means basil seed pouch, H2 chives seed pouch, P pot, M seed-starting-mix sachet, K marker, T catch tray and C start card. Layout changes are allowed; altered wording or reassigned codes fails.

The developed structure, opening mechanism, retention and component positions agree with the selected specification wherever depicted; opening and storage states remain physically compatible. All developed surface artwork and package views express the selected visual direction, with coherent typography, graphic treatment and surface assignments; component-specific wording and functional layouts may differ.

Every visible component code retains the same meaning across alternatives, specifications and developed images: H1 basil pouch, H2 chives pouch, P pot, M mix sachet, K marker, T tray and C card. Packing and storage depictions respect the fixed component records and distinguish the complete sixteen-piece kit from the smaller dry remainder after the first session.
